name: tictactoe
description: Tic-tac-toe (morpion) game service. Human plays X by default, the LLM plays O. Every interaction — starting a round, quitting, and EVERY move — comes in on `game.tictactoe.command` with content either a JSON `{action, mark?, cell?}` or a loose string. Recognised actions: `start` (optionally with `mark: 'X'|'O'`), `quit`, `status`, and `move` (the numpad-indexed cell 1-9 in `cell`). Examples — content=`{"action":"start"}`, `{"action":"move","cell":5}`, or loose strings like `start O` / `move 5`. The board is numpad-indexed 1-9 (1=top-left, 5=center, 9=bottom-right). Narrates every state change on `chat.response` so every connected chat surface stays in sync.

default_subscriptions.description: Sole entry point for the game. Publish `{"action":"start"}` to start (optionally with `mark: 'X'|'O'`), `{"action":"quit"}` to abandon, `{"action":"status"}` to publish current state. To play a move: `{"action":"move","cell":5}` — cell is the numpad-indexed 1-9 position. The brain node should forward every digit the player types here while a game is active; legality + game logic happen inside the handler.
